en: The postcard displays a black-and-white photograph of a large wooden and brick building with a prominent chimney and several people—including women in traditional attire and a horse with a cart—standing outside. The building has decorative wooden elements and large windows. The text at the top reads 'MEJERIET VID ÖSTERBY BRUK.' The reverse side shows handwritten Swedish text addressed to 'Fröken Ingrid Frisk, Svartmangatan 11, Stockholm,' and is formatted as an old-style postcard (BREFKORT/CARTE POSTALE).
